title: In one room: "User not in room" when sending messages, "Not a known room" when trying to leave

labels.name: T-Defect
labels.description: Bugs, crashes, hangs, security vulnerabilities, or other reported issues.

body:
### Description

Since an upgrade of Synapse to 1.30.0 (and a server restart), I encounter significant problems in a specific room (which before worked without any problem). Here are the symptoms:
- If I try to send a message in the room using Element, I get the message `User @XXX:YYY not in room  FhnTYZhdgIipdYUdar:otherserver.org (None)`, where `@XXX:YYY` is my userid.
- If I try to leave the room, I get the message `Not a known room`
- I can still read the history, and if someone sends a message to the room, I can see it as well.


<!-- Describe here the problem that you are experiencing -->

### Steps to reproduce

- install synapse 1.30.0
- reboot synapse
- try to send a message into one of my rooms (note: only this specific room triggers these symptoms)

_What I expect:_ the message is sent successfully
_What I get_: the error message shown above

### Version information

<!-- IMPORTANT: please answer the following questions, to help us narrow down the problem -->

<!-- Was this issue identified on matrix.org or another homeserver? -->
- **Homeserver**: my own homeserver

If not matrix.org:

- **Version**: 1.30.0
